newsitem.title: USA: WMS Industries seeks IRS ruling on spin-off.
newsitem.headline: WMS Industries seeks IRS ruling on spin-off.

text.p: WMS Industries Inc said Wednesday it submitted a ruling request to the U.S. Internal Revenue Service, seeking a determination that the proposed spin-off of its hotel/casino business will be treated as a tax free dividend.
As previously reported, WMS's board has approved the spin off of 100 percent of its Puerto Rico-based hotel, casino and management business to stockholders.
WMS said it currently expects the spin-off to take place in the quarter ended March 31.
WMS designs, makes and sells coin-operated and home video games, novelty games, video lottery terminals and gaming devices.
